subject: Marketplace reseller activation — PP Offer entity validation & commission mapping
messages:
From: Sara Moore <sara@cloudresell.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Kickoff: CPPO onboarding for CloudResell

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. CloudResell is ready to move our CPPO (Channel Private Offer) with you — legal asked us to get the entity and tax information squared away before we request the private offer in AWS. Can you share Redwood's standard onboarding checklist and an example of how you map commissions to the reseller entity?

We anticipate a handful of reseller entities across EMEA and US, and we want to make sure the PO/invoice flow matches AWS settlement requirements. Proposed timeline is: entity validation + W-9/W-8 collection this week, CPPO request next week, go-live in two weeks.

Who should I send legal/finance docs to, and do you have a template for the entity matrix?

Thanks,
Sara
Partnerships Lead
CloudResell, Inc.
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Moore <sara@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: CPPO onboarding for CloudResell

Hi Sara — great to hear. Looping in Ben (channel ops) and Grace (finance) to make onboarding smooth; Vivek is our channel partner PM and will own the CPPO request once entity validation is complete.

Quick plan:
- You send the entity matrix + tax docs (W-9/W-8) to me (attachments ok).
- Ben will confirm commission rates / revenue split and map each reseller legal entity to the Marketplace seller account they want credited.
- Grace will confirm invoicing entity and AP contact and provide Redwood's billing remittance instructions.
- Vivek will raise the CPPO in AWS and track the DocuSign/PO steps.

Please include: legal entity name, country, tax ID/VAT, marketplace account ID (if already created), AP email, and whether the entity will invoice Redwood or expects settlement through AWS marketplace settlement. I attached our short onboarding checklist as a Drive link here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/marketplace-ppo-checklist — send the matrix back and we'll triage.

Tentative dates: entity validation by 2027-04-28, CPPO request 2027-05-03, go-live 2027-05-10 (subject to AWS turnaround).

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB)

From: Sara Moore <sara@cloudresell.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: CPPO onboarding for CloudResell

Monica / team — attaching what you asked for.

Attachments: reseller_w9.pdf (application/pdf, 95 KB); entity_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 14 KB)

Excerpt from the matrix we sent:
- CloudResell, Inc. (US) | EIN 12-3456789 | Marketplace acct: cloudresell-us | AP: ap.us@cloudresell.com | invoices to Redwood
- CloudResell EU Ltd (IE) | VAT IE1234567 | Marketplace acct: cloudresell-eu | AP: ap.eu@cloudresell.com | prefers AWS settlement

We can provide PO templates if Redwood needs them. We plan to submit the CPPO request once you confirm the commission mapping per entity.

Thanks,
Sara

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Moore <sara@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: CPPO onboarding for CloudResell

Thanks Sara — helpful matrix. A few clarifications from channel ops so AWS settlement maps cleanly:

1) Commission mapping per entity: we pay partner commission on invoice net of marketplace fees. For entities that invoice Redwood directly (CloudResell, Inc. US) we'll set up a standard reseller commission of 18% on net ARR for the first 12 months unless otherwise negotiated. For EU entity using AWS settlement, commission will be recognized via Marketplace settlement and we need the Marketplace Account ID and the AWS Partner Central ID.

2) Billing entity vs tax entity: confirm whether CloudResell EU Ltd will be the invoicing party for EU customers or if AWS marketplace handles payout — that determines whether we need VAT registration copies.

3) For the CPPO request, we need the reseller's Marketplace Seller ID, the AWS account alias, and the list of SKUs/pricing you want in the private offer request. If you don't have the seller ID, give me the Marketplace account email and we can look it up.

Suggested next step: Sara to confirm seller IDs and we (Vivek) will create the draft CPPO request and a DocuSign template for the PO flow.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Channel Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Moore <sara@cloudresell.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: CPPO onboarding for CloudResell

Hi all — from finance side a couple quick items to reduce settlement friction: 

- For US entity invoicing Redwood: AP should send invoices to billing@redwoodinference.com with PO# in subject. We will route payment via ACH; please include bank remittance instructions on the invoice.
- For EU entities settling via AWS: we need VAT registration docs and the legal invoice recipient name exactly as on their VAT registration.
- Please confirm whether CloudResell EU Ltd will issue invoices to Redwood or accept AWS settlement. If AWS handles payout, we will require the monthly marketplace settlement report and a matching invoice from CloudResell for commission reconciliation.

I'll attach a short checklist for finance onboarding and the billing remittance template. If you prefer, we can run a 20-minute finance-to-finance call to confirm.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: finance-onboarding-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 26 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Moore <sara@cloudresell.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: CPPO onboarding for CloudResell

Thanks team — quick status and next steps: 

1) Sara: confirm Marketplace Seller ID(s) for the two entities by EOD 2027-05-03 and confirm whether EU entity will invoice Redwood or use AWS settlement.
2) Ben: once seller IDs and SKUs are confirmed, I'll prepare the CPPO draft in Partner Central and link the DocuSign PO template.
3) Grace: we'll share the marketplace settlement report template and sync if needed.

DocuSign link (draft onboarding PO): https://app.docusign.com/templates/PPOffer-Onboarding-Template — Sara if you can acknowledge and fill the seller IDs in the attached matrix, I will kick the CPPO.

I'll own the timeline and provide a Go/No-Go update by 2027-05-05.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Channel Partner Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 650-555-0144
